before.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Generate the BEFORE image for an interactive advertising before/after comparison for the BLINK creative studio website. Asset: high resolution portrait product photograph, aspect ratio 4:5. Subject: a single generic unbranded matte pale ivory 330ml aluminum citrus sparkling drink can, upright and centered, full can visible with comfortable space. Simple label with one small flat orange circle above the exact word 'CITRUS', and tiny 'SPARKLING' underneath; no other brand or text. The can occupies 56 percent of image height with its center at 52 percent from top, photographed straight-on with a tiny glimpse of top. Scene: plain pale warm gray studio background and simple flat tabletop, ordinary soft flat lighting, low contrast washed-out catalog photography, dull but still technically sharp and credible. It must feel generic and uninspired, not deliberately broken. No overlay captions, no watermark, no before/after text. Preserve room around can for a later dramatic advertising edit. Deliver one photograph, not a split comparison.

variants.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing / precise-object-edit. Edit this BEFORE photograph into an extraordinary premium citrus drink campaign photograph for an interactive before/after reveal. Exact invariants: same ivory aluminum can, identical product silhouette, label, wording CITRUS and SPARKLING, orange circle mark, same can position and scale, upright same perspective and aligned to original. Keep the can boundaries precisely in place for slider alignment. Transform art direction around it: rich saturated burnt orange and amber studio atmosphere, a beautifully controlled translucent golden citrus splash sweeps behind the can like a sculptural ribbon, crisp droplets suspended in air and two freshly sliced oranges at the lower sides with visible juicy pulp and subtle leaves, luminous golden backlighting, directional softbox edge light and polished dimensional product lighting, convincing condensation droplets on can. Foreground warm orange gloss with soft natural reflections, exquisite tactile details, strong clean focal hierarchy, sophisticated luxury beverage photography, no chaotic collage, no plastic-looking fruit. Same portrait canvas and framing as original. Leave some negative space above the can. Do NOT add advertising headlines, badges, captions, watermarks, extra labels, logos or any text beyond the existing identical product label. The BLINK website will add accessible typography in HTML. Deliver only the transformed AFTER image, not a split comparison.
